pmsampsize-package
pmsampsize: Sample Size Calculations for Clinical Prediction Models

Model development

Closed-form criteria for continuous, binary and survival outcomes.

pmsampsize()
pmsampsize - Sample Size for Development of a Prediction Model

External validation

Criteria for the external validation of an existing model (binary outcomes).

pmvalsampsize()
pmvalsampsize - Sample Size for External Validation of a Prediction Model

Generalised approach

Simulation-based sample size for developing a model with a binary outcome, using any model-fitting method.
